verdict.rationale: Unity serves llms.txt files at the unity.com marketing root, the docs.unity.com site-wide index, and the Unity CLI docs section, so an agent can be pointed at some agent-oriented docs. However, the core engine Manual and API docs on docs.unity3d.com return 404 for llms.txt and have no .md mirrors, so the main documentation is not machine-readable. Missing for 10: an llms.txt and markdown mirrors for the docs.unity3d.com Manual/Scripting API, and independent corroboration of agents using these files.
